The Cache

A favour for a favour: Sahilya will help obtain Hadagan enlistment papers if you retrieve one of her two bags of stolen goods hidden in the desert.

Objectives

Go to the gorge

Reach the islet

Kill the ogre

Kill the troll

Collect the goods from the cache

Collect the goods from storage
